notes: Side view, facing east (No.10 is right-footed: near/right leg kicks, far/left leg plants). GALE never mirrors, so there is no west strip. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). Ground frames sit on contact = the planted boot's toe-tip column on row 102 (constant while the foot is planted; the toe outline is 1 px further right); airborne frames (contact null) sit on pelvis. ball = the 12 px ball guide centre at rest (never drawn in the frame); boot = instep point; head = skull point; eye = the side eye; bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Layers in the studio: Art only (no Num/Ball layer; numbers are in Art). Strike: one fixed patch of turf. Plant (far/left) toe-tip (76,102) on F5a-F7 (identical boot pixels); ball at rest (83,96). F8/F8b are airborne: drawn at their canvas pelvis, placed so that pelvis lands on world = [x,y] in Strike-canvas coords (sprite offset +5,-5 and +8,-2). F9/F10 land on the near toe-tip (97,102) in the same canvas. GALE 2: the Strike canvas origin = Run canvas origin + 56 px. F7: boot/laces are measured on the drawn boot (the drawn instep is 8 px past the rest ball, the ball has already left); ballHit = the ball tangent to those laces; lacesKey/bootKey = the library contact key at the rest ball (77,96)/(76,94). F7 is not on screen in GALE (shot 3 goes M3 -> F8). GALE v2 (appended, studio Strike Side frames 9-10; frames 1-8 and their data unchanged): F9r = the recoil skid, a ground frame on the plant HEEL (contact (78,102)), drawn at the Strike canvas origin; GALE v2 shot 5 slides it 10 world px west (outQuad) over 0.80-1.04. F9s = the step out of the skid (breakdown), drawn at Strike-canvas dx -10 (heel contact (78,102) -> world 68 = F9r's slid heel: no slip; world = its pelvis in Strike-canvas coords) over 1.04-1.12; then F9 1.12 and F10 1.30 at dx -18. toe = the plant toe tip (F9r: toe up 26 deg), kickToe = the kicking boot's toe tip. Never cut F9r straight to F9.
